property_summary: For any external call to onERC721Received that does not revert, the returned bytes4 value must equal ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector; the buggy version returns 0x150b7a01, violating this rule.
change_summary: Change the return value from ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector to a different bytes4 value (0x150b7a01).
